publicProfile.headline: Multimodal AI Research Engineer — speech, vision-language and video models from research to production
publicProfile.summary: Research/ML engineer spanning video, vision-language and speech AI. Leads end-to-end speech recognition development and serving at a seed-stage startup (Korean-English code-switching STT, 200k+ monthly API calls), previously did VLM data synthesis, multi-node fine-tuning and evaluation at a large cloud company, and began in a university computer vision lab. First author at ACL Findings 2025 and EACL Findings 2026. Strong communicator: long-running tech blog, YouTube lectures, invited talks and conference organizing. Extra materials indicate founding a speech AI company focused on AI as entertainment.
